content.short: Trading suite for EVM chains that hunts new tokens fast through a Telegram bot and web terminal.
content.description: Blazing is built for traders chasing new tokens the moment they appear. It combines a Telegram bot with a synced web terminal, starts transactions in under a millisecond, adds MEV protection, and offers memescopes for each chain, including Four.meme launches on BNB Chain. The team publishes speed tests against rival bots on BNB Chain, Base, Avalanche and Sonic.
content.meta: Blazing is a Telegram bot and web terminal for trading new tokens on EVM chains, with sub-millisecond starts and MEV protection.
